title: Please add Facebook login soon
body:
From what I've read in the description, it seems like a step in the right direction, and I wholly support that. However, it doesn't yet allow the login of users registered via facebook, which I find to be a big con - and I understand it's only a beta release, but a lot of potential users are cut off from even trying out and testing the app.
Might want to get to work on that asap.
author: Taranoleion
